env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Given a natural-language task, MolmoWeb autonomously controls a web browser -- clicking, typing, scrolling, and navigating -- to complete the task.
env_context_strategy.note: Web domain: agent explores via browser actions; URL and title of current page also appended (paper Sec. 3.2).

context_compaction.evidence_quote: the history of actions taken in 10 prior steps is appended as context along with the URL and title of the current page.
context_compaction.note: Only last 10 actions kept; only current screenshot sent. Paper-level description, code not seen.

observation_format.evidence_quote: given a task instruction and a webpage screenshot, they predict the next browser action, requiring no access to HTML, accessibility trees, or specialized APIs.
observation_format.note: Default molmoweb agent. Shipped gemini_axtree/gpt_axtree agent types use accessibility tree (a11y_tree) but are baselines, not the MolmoWeb harness.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The model predicts a JSON object encoding both athoughtand anactionspecifying the operation to perform.

tool_count.evidence_quote: send_msg_to_user(msg)Display a message to the user
tool_count.note: Counted 13 actions in paper Table 3 action space; actions are in-text, not function schemas.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Given a natural-language task, MolmoWeb autonomously controls a web browser -- clicking, typing, scrolling, and navigating -- to complete the task.
edit_primitive.note: Action space (paper Table 3) has no file-editing action; browser agent.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The full action space is described in table 3.
tool_schema_source.note: Action space is fixed and learned by SFT; no schema generation code seen.

protocol_standardization.note: No source/dependency grep available; only file tree and README.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The action is executed in the browser to yield a new observation and this loop repeats until the task is complete.
loop_primitives.note: Paper also describes best-of-N parallel rollouts with LLM judge as an experiment; not shown as a shipped config option.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: It then predicts a natural language thought followed by a browser action.
planning_granularity.note: Planner/Verifier multi-agent system is data-generation only.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: At each step, the agent receives the task instruction, current screenshot, and action history as input.
multi_agent_topology.note: Multi-agent Planner/Operator/Verifier harness used only for synthetic data generation.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: At each step, the agent receives the task instruction, current screenshot, and action history as input.

human_in_loop.note: Agent code not included in evidence; follow-up queries via continue_run exist but are not gating.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: since past thoughts and actions are provided as context at every step

long_term_memory.note: No config/source surface available to check.

state_persistence.note: continue_run continues a finished session with a follow-up query, not resume of interrupted run; code not available.

self_verification.note: LLM judges exist only as post-hoc benchmark scoring (H3), not in the agent loop; agent code not seen.

retry_policy.note: Paper: up to 10 retries on environment errors in evaluation; code not seen.

execution_isolation.note: Benchmark default local Chromium; inference client default is Browserbase (remote); browser_use cloud also available.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Given a natural-language task, MolmoWeb autonomously controls a web browser -- clicking, typing, scrolling, and navigating -- to complete the task.
network_policy.note: Operates on live open web; no network config seen.
